Labspace Docker Sandboxes with GitHub Copilot

Docker Sandboxes with GitHub Copilot

In this lab you use GitHub Copilot inside a Docker Sandbox to work on DevBoard, a small issue tracker (FastAPI + Next.js). Along the way you see how sandboxes keep your machine, your files and your credentials safe while an AI agent does real work.

Pick a version

  • Simulated lab: every command runs in your browser, scripted. Nothing to install, no Docker account and no Copilot usage.
  • Labspace preview: a static preview of the Labspace version of the lab.
  • Hands-on lab: the source repository, to run the lab on your own machine with sbx.

Duration: about 60 minutes.
